diagnostic.finding: The service reported generator_unavailable after 180684.548 ms, consistent with the configured 180-second request timeout. No provider response or generated claim was captured. The precise HTTP exception subtype was not retained. A later read-only check found the Ollama API reachable and no model loaded.

examples.question: في نسخة 31 مارس 2022، ماذا تنص المادة 151 بخصوص الاتفاقية المكتوبة عند فتح الحساب وتسليم نسخة للعميل؟

diagnostic.finding: The fixed BM25 abstention gate rejected this question before calling Qwen. The maximum lexical overlap with the article-151 passage was 0.2142857143, below the fixed threshold of 0.25. No provider generation or citation validation occurred.

conditions: Generic questions use hybrid retrieval. Article-targeted BM25 questions explicitly name article 151 and the 2022 edition. These heterogeneous probes have no aggregate performance rate. Retained prior cases predate the final generation-context changes.
runtime_context: Docker/OpenSearch validation was running concurrently. Resource contention is a possible context for the timeout; causality was not established.
integration_conclusion: Qwen generation remains experimental and unvalidated. These heterogeneous local probes do not establish generated-answer faithfulness or an aggregate performance rate.
